'''Canned apples''' are the preservation of the [[apple]]. They heal {{Hp|6}} and grant {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} for 1 minute.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/canned_apples.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[baked apple]], sugar and a glass bottle. Obtaining a baked apple unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating canned apples takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|6}} and gives Regeneration I for 1:00. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
